## 1. Architectural Overview & System Design

PerGo is a high-performance, self-hosted, open-source Omnichannel Headless CPaaS engineered in Go. It exposes a single unified REST API (`POST /messages` or `POST /api/v1/messages`) that abstracts away multi-provider messaging fragmentation under one standardized JSON payload:
- **WhatsApp Web (Unofficial)**: Driven by `whatsmeow`, with multi-device support, encrypted session credentials at rest, and staggered dispatch (1-3s random delay) for safety.
- **WhatsApp Cloud (Official WABA)**: Meta Cloud API integration with official message templates, interactive components, and Meta Flow encryption.
- **Telegram Bot API**: Native bot integration with automated webhook registration.

### Core Architectural Boundaries
- **Data Plane (PerGo OSS)**: Handles channel connectivity, message ingestion, durable JetStream queuing, dispatch workers, media streaming, webhooks, and local MCP server tools. It is completely decoupled from commercial billing, plan quotas, or credit cards.
- **Control Plane (PergoCloud SaaS)**: Managed control plane handling multi-tenant subscriptions, Stripe billing, Pix payments, residential proxy pools, and Meta Tech Provider embedded onboarding.

### Performance Envelope
- Ingestion Throughput: >= 500 messages/sec sustained.
- Ingestion Latency: <= 50ms p99.
- Backpressure: 1,000-message per-session queue limit enforced before enqueue (HTTP 429 when exceeded).
- Broker: NATS JetStream `WorkQueuePolicy` with durable consumer ack/retry.
- Persistence: PostgreSQL 16+ via `pgx/v5` with connection pooling and audit partitioning.

---

## 2. API Reference & Unified Message Dispatch

A API do **PerGo** foi projetada para ser simples, unificada e performática, permitindo o envio de mensagens em canais variados a partir de um único payload padronizado JSON.

### Autenticação
Todas as requisições para a API pública de mensagens devem conter a chave de API (API Key) do seu Workspace fornecida no cabeçalho `Authorization`:

```http
Authorization: Bearer <WORKSPACE_API_KEY>
```

### 2.1 Enviar Mensagem (`POST /messages` ou `POST /api/v1/messages`)
Envia uma mensagem (texto, mídia, template oficial ou interativa) para um canal específico (Telegram, WhatsApp Cloud ou WhatsApp Web).

* **Endpoint:** `POST /messages` (ou `POST /api/v1/messages`)
* **Content-Type:** `application/json`
* **Respostas:**
  * `202 Accepted` — Mensagem recebida com sucesso e enfileirada para envio durável.
  * `400 Bad Request` — Payload inválido ou malformado.
  * `401 Unauthorized` — Chave de API inválida ou ausente.
  * `422 Unprocessable Entity` — Erro de validação de regra de negócio ou capacidade.
  * `429 Too Many Requests` — Fila de retenção de backpressure atingiu o limite (1.000 pendentes).

#### Payload Padrão (Mensagem de Texto)
```json
{
  "to": "5511999999999",
  "channel": "whatsapp",
  "body": "Olá! Esta é uma mensagem de teste enviada pelo PerGo."
}
```

* **Campos:**
  * `to` (string, obrigatório): Destinatário. Para WhatsApp, formato E.164 com DDI e DDD (ex: `5511999999999`). Para Telegram, o ID numérico do chat (`chat_id`).
  * `channel` (string, obrigatório): Canal de disparo. Valores válidos: `"whatsapp"` (WhatsApp Web/whatsmeow), `"whatsapp_cloud"` (WABA oficial) ou `"telegram"`.
  * `body` (string, obrigatório): Texto da mensagem.

#### Envio de Mídia (Imagens, Documentos e Áudios)
```json
{
  "to": "5511999999999",
  "channel": "whatsapp_cloud",
  "body": "",
  "media": {
    "media_url": "https://meuservidor.com/comprovante.pdf",
    "media_type": "document",
    "filename": "comprovante.pdf",
    "caption": "Segue o comprovante de pagamento."
  }
}
```
* Subcampos do objeto `media`: `media_url` (string, obrigatório), `media_type` (`"image"|"document"|"audio"`), `filename` (string), `caption` (string).

#### Envio de Templates Oficiais (WhatsApp Cloud)
```json
{
  "to": "5511999999999",
  "channel": "whatsapp_cloud",
  "body": "",
  "template_name": "welcome_message",
  "language": "pt_BR",
  "components": [
    {
      "type": "body",
      "parameters": [
        {
          "type": "text",
          "text": "João"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

#### Mensagens Interativas: Botões de Resposta Rápida (Reply Buttons)
```json
{
  "to": "5511999999999",
  "channel": "whatsapp_cloud",
  "type": "interactive",
  "fallback_behavior": "degrade",
  "interactive": {
    "type": "button",
    "header": { "text": "Pesquisa de Satisfação" },
    "body": { "text": "Como você avalia nosso atendimento?" },
    "footer": { "text": "Selecione uma opção abaixo:" },
    "action": {
      "buttons": [
        { "type": "reply", "reply": { "id": "btn_otimo", "title": "Ótimo" } },
        { "type": "reply", "reply": { "id": "btn_bom", "title": "Bom" } }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

#### Mensagens Interativas: Menus em Lista (List Menus)
```json
{
  "to": "5511999999999",
  "channel": "whatsapp_cloud",
  "type": "interactive",
  "fallback_behavior": "degrade",
  "interactive": {
    "type": "list",
    "header": { "text": "Central de Atendimento" },
    "body": { "text": "Escolha o departamento desejado:" },
    "footer": { "text": "Horário de atendimento 08h às 20h" },
    "action": {
      "button": "Ver Opções",
      "sections": [
        {
          "title": "Departamentos",
          "rows": [
            { "id": "opt_suporte", "title": "Suporte Técnico", "description": "Dúvidas técnicas e incidentes" },
            { "id": "opt_financeiro", "title": "Financeiro", "description": "Faturas, 2ª via de boleto e Pix" }
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

## 3. Headless CPaaS & Integration APIs Reference

This section describes the 100% programmatic headless REST APIs for PerGo, allowing external platforms (CRMs, ERPs, SaaS platforms, AI orchestrators) to provision tenants, manage connection lifecycles (including real-time QR pairing via SSE and polling), configure webhook subscriptions, and perform seamless Single Sign-On (SSO) operator hand-off into the native admin console.

### 3.1 Master Authentication & Workspace Provisioning
The workspace provisioning endpoint is secured with **Master Authentication** using `PERGO_MASTER_KEY` (or `PERGO_ADMIN_PASSWORD` as fallback).
Provide the key via:
```http
Authorization: Bearer <PERGO_MASTER_KEY>
```
or
```http
X-Master-Key: <PERGO_MASTER_KEY>
```

#### Provision Workspace
Creates a new tenant workspace and automatically generates a default workspace API key and webhook signing secret.
* **Method & Path:** `POST /api/v1/workspaces`
* **Request Body:**
```json
{
  "name": "Acme Corp",
  "generate_api_key": true,
  "generate_webhook_secret": true
}
```
* **Response (`201 Created`):**
```json
{
  "id": "a5e8c1b2-3f4d-4e5a-8b9c-0d1e2f3a4b5c",
  "name": "Acme Corp",
  "api_key": "pgo_live_8f3d1b9a7c2e4f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c",
  "webhook_secret": "9a8b7c6d5e4f3a2b1c0d9e8f7a6b5c4d3e2f1a0b9c8d7e6f5a4b3c2d1e0f9a8b",
  "created_at": "2026-08-15T00:00:00Z"
}
```

#### List Workspaces
Lists all configured tenant workspaces.
* **Method & Path:** `GET /api/v1/workspaces?limit=50`
* **Response (`200 OK`):**
```json
{
  "workspaces": [
    {
      "id": "a5e8c1b2-3f4d-4e5a-8b9c-0d1e2f3a4b5c",
      "name": "Acme Corp",
      "pii_opt_in": false,
      "webhook_secret": "9a8b7c6d5e4f3a2b1c0d9e8f7a6b5c4d3e2f1a0b9c8d7e6f5a4b3c2d1e0f9a8b",
      "created_at": "2026-08-15T00:00:00Z",
      "updated_at": "2026-08-15T00:00:00Z"
    }
  ]
}
```

### 3.2 Connection Lifecycle & QR Pairing APIs
All workspace-level endpoints require the workspace API key (`Authorization: Bearer <WORKSPACE_API_KEY>`).

#### Initiate Pairing (WhatsApp Web)
Starts an in-memory pairing session for WhatsApp Web (whatsmeow) and generates ephemeral QR codes.
* **Method & Path:** `POST /api/v1/connections/pair` (alias: `POST /api/v1/devices/pair`)
* **Request Body:**
```json
{
  "channel": "whatsapp",
  "phone": "5511999998888",
  "name": "WhatsApp Support",
  "proxy_url": ""
}
```
* **Response (`200 OK`):**
```json
{
  "connection_id": "7b1c3d5e-9f8a-4b2c-8d1e-0a2b3c4d5e6f",
  "phone": "5511999998888",
  "status": "pairing_started",
  "message": "Sessão iniciada. Obtenha o QR code via polling ou stream SSE."
}
```

#### Get QR Code State (Polling)
* **Method & Path:** `GET /api/v1/connections/:id/qr`
* **Response (`200 OK` - Pending Scan):**
```json
{
  "status": "pending",
  "code": "2@vJ8...base64rawstring...",
  "qr_data_url": "data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAA...",
  "pairing_code": "",
  "expires_at": "2026-08-15T00:01:25Z",
  "message": "Scan the QR code in WhatsApp",
  "connection_id": "7b1c3d5e-9f8a-4b2c-8d1e-0a2b3c4d5e6f"
}
```

#### Real-Time QR Code Stream (Server-Sent Events - SSE)
Streams pairing updates in real time using SSE. Closes automatically upon successful scan or terminal error.
* **Method & Path:** `GET /api/v1/connections/:id/qr/stream`
* **Response Header:** `Content-Type: text/event-stream`
* **Stream Events:**
```text
event: qr
data: {"status":"pending","code":"2@abc...","qr_data_url":"data:image/png;base64,...","expires_at":"2026-08-15T00:01:25Z"}

event: paired
data: {"status":"paired","message":"device paired successfully","connection_id":"7b1c3d5e-9f8a-4b2c-8d1e-0a2b3c4d5e6f"}
```

#### List Connections
* **Method & Path:** `GET /api/v1/connections`
* **Response (`200 OK`):**
```json
{
  "connections": [
    {
      "id": "7b1c3d5e-9f8a-4b2c-8d1e-0a2b3c4d5e6f",
      "name": "WhatsApp Support",
      "slug": "whatsapp-support",
      "channel": "whatsapp",
      "sender_identity": "5511999998888",
      "status": "connected",
      "is_default": true,
      "push_name": "Acme Support",
      "connected_since": "2026-08-15T00:02:00Z",
      "created_at": "2026-08-15T00:00:00Z",
      "updated_at": "2026-08-15T00:02:00Z"
    }
  ]
}
```

#### Disconnect Connection
* **Method & Path:** `DELETE /api/v1/connections/:id`
* **Response (`200 OK`):** `{"status":"disconnected","connection_id":"7b1c3d5e-..."}`

#### Register WhatsApp Cloud (WABA) Connection
* **Method & Path:** `POST /api/v1/connections/waba`
* **Request Body:**
```json
{
  "name": "Acme WhatsApp Cloud",
  "phone_number_id": "98765432101",
  "waba_account_id": "12345678901",
  "token": "EAABbCcDd123...",
  "verify_token": "custom_verify_token",
  "app_secret": "meta_app_secret_xyz",
  "display_phone_number": "+55 11 98888-7777",
  "verified_name": "Acme Official Support"
}
```

#### Register Telegram Bot Connection
* **Method & Path:** `POST /api/v1/connections/telegram`
* **Request Body:**
```json
{
  "name": "Acme Telegram Support",
  "token": "123456789:ABCdefGhIJKlmNoPQRsTUVwxyZ",
  "secret_token": "optional_custom_secret"
}
```

### 3.3 Webhook Subscriptions REST API
Programmatic CRUD for webhook subscribers with automated HMAC-SHA256 signing secret generation and SSRF protection.

* **Create:** `POST /api/v1/webhooks/subscriptions`
  ```json
  {
    "url": "https://api.externalcrm.com/webhooks/pergo",
    "events": ["message.received", "message.delivered", "message.failed", "connection.status"],
    "is_active": true
  }
  ```
* **List:** `GET /api/v1/webhooks/subscriptions`
* **Get:** `GET /api/v1/webhooks/subscriptions/:id`
* **Update:** `PUT /api/v1/webhooks/subscriptions/:id`
* **Delete:** `DELETE /api/v1/webhooks/subscriptions/:id`

---

## 4. Outbound Webhook Security Signatures (HMAC-SHA256)

PerGo secures all outbound HTTP webhooks delivered to subscribers using an HMAC-SHA256 signature header (`X-PerGo-Signature`). This allows your application server to cryptographically verify that webhook payloads originated from your PerGo gateway and were not tampered with in transit.

### 4.1 Signature Header Format
The `X-PerGo-Signature` header uses the standard timestamped format:
```http
X-PerGo-Signature: t=1754179200,v1=a1b2c3d4e5f67890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890
```
Where:
- `t`: Unix timestamp (in seconds) when the signature was computed.
- `v1`: Hex-encoded HMAC-SHA256 digest of `${timestamp}.${raw_payload_bytes}` using your workspace or subscription secret key.

### 4.2 Verification Code Examples

#### Go (net/http / Echo)
```go
package webhookverifier

import (
	"crypto/hmac"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"crypto/subtle"
	"encoding/hex"
	"math"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

func VerifyPerGoSignature(rawBody []byte, signatureHeader string, secret string) bool {
	if signatureHeader == "" {
		return false
	}

	var timestamp, expectedSig string
	parts := strings.Split(signatureHeader, ",")
	for _, part := range parts {
		kv := strings.SplitN(part, "=", 2)
		if len(kv) == 2 {
			if kv[0] == "t" {
				timestamp = kv[1]
			} else if kv[0] == "v1" {
				expectedSig = kv[1]
			}
		}
	}

	if timestamp == "" || expectedSig == "" {
		return false
	}

	ts, err := strconv.ParseInt(timestamp, 10, 64)
	if err != nil || math.Abs(float64(time.Now().Unix()-ts)) > 300 {
		return false // Replay protection (5 minutes tolerance)
	}

	mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
	mac.Write([]byte(timestamp + "."))
	mac.Write(rawBody)
	computedSig := hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))

	return subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(computedSig), []byte(expectedSig)) == 1
}
```

#### Node.js (TypeScript / Express)
```javascript
const crypto = require('crypto');

function verifyPerGoSignature(rawBody, signatureHeader, secret) {
  if (!signatureHeader) return false;

  const parts = signatureHeader.split(',');
  let timestamp = '';
  let expectedSignature = '';

  for (const part of parts) {
    const [key, value] = part.split('=');
    if (key === 't') timestamp = value;
    if (key === 'v1') expectedSignature = value;
  }

  if (!timestamp || !expectedSignature) return false;

  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  if (Math.abs(now - parseInt(timestamp, 10)) > 300) return false;

  const hmac = crypto.createHmac('sha256', secret);
  hmac.update(`${timestamp}.`);
  hmac.update(rawBody);
  const computedSignature = hmac.digest('hex');

  return crypto.timingSafeEqual(
    Buffer.from(computedSignature, 'utf8'),
    Buffer.from(expectedSignature, 'utf8')
  );
}
```

#### Python (Flask / FastAPI)
```python
import hmac
import hashlib
import time

def verify_pergo_signature(raw_body: bytes, signature_header: str, secret: str) -> bool:
    if not signature_header:
        return False
    
    parts = dict(part.split('=', 1) for part in signature_header.split(',') if '=' in part)
    timestamp = parts.get('t')
    expected_sig = parts.get('v1')
    
    if not timestamp or not expected_sig:
        return False
        
    if abs(time.time() - int(timestamp)) > 300:
        return False
        
    message = f"{timestamp}.".encode('utf-8') + raw_body
    computed_sig = hmac.new(secret.encode('utf-8'), message, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    
    return hmac.compare_digest(computed_sig, expected_sig)
```

---

## 5. WhatsApp Interactive & Meta Flow Engine Architecture (ADR-0012)

### Architectural Decisions
1. **Stateless Cryptographic Flow Tokens**: Meta Flow sessions use compact HMAC-SHA256 signed `flow_token` payloads encoding `(workspace_id, connection_id, contact_id, flow_id, exp)` with a default 7-day TTL. This eliminates database I/O bottlenecks during high-volume broadcasts (500+ msgs/sec) and prevents cross-tenant tampering without stateful session tracking in PostgreSQL.
2. **Synchronous Webhook Delegation for Flow Data Exchange**: PerGo's Flow Endpoint (`/api/v1/waba/flows/data-exchange`) acts as a pure cryptographic and protocol termination seam. It decrypts incoming RSA/AES-128-GCM payloads, forwards decrypted JSON synchronously to the workspace's configured `flow_webhook_url` within a 2500ms timeout budget, and re-encrypts the partner's JSON screen response for Meta. If the partner endpoint fails or times out, PerGo returns an encrypted fallback error screen (`{"screen": "ERROR", ...}`) to ensure a graceful WhatsApp client experience.
3. **Automated RSA Keypair Lifecycle**: WABA connections automatically generate an RSA 2048-bit keypair upon creation (persisted in credentials encrypted with AES-256-GCM at rest). The public key PEM is exportable via API (`GET /api/v1/connections/:id/flow-public-key`) and the admin console for upload to Meta Flow Builder.
4. **Configurable Cross-Channel Degradation**: Interactive messages dispatched to connections lacking native UI parity adhere to `fallback_behavior: "degrade" | "fail"`. By default (`degrade`), buttons and lists degrade to numbered text menus, while `fail` returns a terminal error.

---

## 6. Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server Reference

PerGo embeds a native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server running via `stdio` (for local autonomous coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity) and via Streamable HTTP / SSE mounted at `/api/mcp` for networked agents.

### Tools Exposed
- `list_workspaces`: Lists available tenant workspaces and active configurations.
- `create_workspace`: Provisions a new workspace and generates operational credentials.
- `get_connection_status`: Fetches socket health, uptime, and state for any configured connection.
- `get_connection_qr_code`: Retrieves base64 pairing QR codes for WhatsApp Web.
- `disconnect_connection`: Safely tears down channel connections.
- `send_message`: Dispatches unified messages with optional idempotency keys.
- `diagnose_connection_health`: Evaluates socket ping, proxy latency, and credential validity.
- `simulate_webhook_event`: Dispatches synthetic webhook events and captures the subscriber's response code and latency.

---

## 7. Data Retention & LGPD Media Purge

PerGo includes a background retention daemon that scans workspaces and automatically purges media files stored in the local/MinIO storage once their age exceeds `workspace.media_retention_days` (configurable per workspace, defaults to 30 days). This ensures continuous GDPR and LGPD compliance without manual operator intervention.

---

## 8. OpenAPI 3.1 & Documentation Endpoints

- **`/llms.txt`**: Curated, token-efficient agent index adhering to llmstxt.org v2 format.
- **`/llms-full.txt`**: Complete concatenated documentation payload.
- **`/docs`**: Embedded standalone offline Scalar API reference viewer.
- **`/openapi.json` & `/openapi.yaml`**: Formal OpenAPI 3.1 specifications.
- **`/healthz` & `/readyz`**: Public health monitoring and liveness probes.
